$comment: Lodging per overnight stop. `stopId` matches `stayAt` in itinerary.json.
Each stop holds a list of candidate options. Set `bookedOptionId` once a
decision is made; until then the Stays page shows the candidates side by
side and the budget uses the cheapest as a placeholder estimate.
pricePerPerson is per person per night in `currency`. Set `halfBoard` when
dinner and breakfast are included, which is the norm in refuges and changes
how much food money to budget separately.
status: idea | contacted | held | booked | rejected

stops.label: Chamonix (before and after)
stops.note: Excluded from the on-trail budget by agreement. Carte d'Hôte from any valley hotel makes the buses free.

options.name: Hotel in the village
options.note: Village has several small hotels. Walk-in is realistic midweek but not in July.

options.name: Auberge de la Nova
options.note: Effectively the only option in the hamlet, and where the navette ticket machine is. Books out months ahead for July — this is the highest-risk night of the trip.

stops.label: Courmayeur (2 nights, includes the rest day)

options.name: Four-star resort and spa
options.note: The planned rest-day splurge. Two nights, so it carries double weight in the budget.

options.name: Village hotel or gîte
options.note: First Swiss night — prices step up here.

options.name: Lakeside hotel
options.note: Proper resort village with choice. Good place to be for an evening lake shot.

options.name: Gîte in Trient
options.note: Tiny hamlet, very limited beds. Col de la Forclaz just above is the fallback.
